findings.reason: the arm's run count and per-landed-node denominator are the record's whole deliverable, and the record has no verdict to fall back on when two readings of its population disagree.
findings.text: §12 defines the population as "the wave's runs" and requires every run listed by id, but nothing states whether a corrective redispatch of a wave run is a separate run of that population; §8 measures a corrective redispatch rate as a first-class quantity, so the event is expected, and at four runs per arm one redispatch is a quarter of an arm's input and repeats a section already in the assignment table, so two nodes would produce different per-arm figures from the same wave

response_events.note: §12 now counts a resume, repair round or corrective redispatch of a wave run inside that run's node, under its original arm, adding no run to the count

done_when-1.note: §12 now counts a resume, repair round or corrective redispatch of a wave run inside that run's node, under its original arm, adding no run to the count

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — §5, §8 and §10 resolve in the same document, §10 is declared `done`, and both `docs/research/fixtures/codex-refused-patch-stream.jsonl` and `docs/research/fixtures/codex-anchored-edit-stream.jsonl` exist in the tree.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — the done-when fixes the population as "the wave's runs" but does not state whether a corrective redispatch of a wave run is itself a wave run, so an arm's count and denominator are underdetermined at four runs per arm.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the record sits at `docs/evidence/fragments/workers-spend-fewer-tokens-per-landed-node/interim-arm-report.html`, an in-repo durable directory that already holds ten sibling fragments.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the changed sentences name mechanisms and record fields (`anchored_edit`, "cumulative input per landed node") and carry no plan label, wave number, ticket or version tag.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the two added sentences close the mis-binning the cited §10 run exposed (a routed treatment run that fails anchored membership is now excluded from both arms, with the reason) and state the form an arm with no landed node reports; §8's stated root cause and §12's confound statement agree with the evidence they cite.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — one deliverable, the interim arm evidence record, and the section's own text keeps the verdict with §8.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §12's landed upstream requirement (§10) is declared `done`, the section carries no `plan-section-depends-on` entry because it produces the interim read before §8's verdict rather than behind it, and its own dispatch gate on the wave is stated in its last sentence.
